en.t: That day, snowflakes were swirling in the air.
The Master liked to eat eel.

units.source_text: 我回去后，名人洗了个热水澡。

en.t: After I went back, the Master took a hot bath.

units.source_text: 据说是由夫人从后面将手伸进他的双腋，搀扶着帮他洗的。

en.t: It was said that his wife put her hands under both his arms from behind, supporting him as she helped him wash.

units.source_text: 不多久，名人就寝，觉得胸口疼痛，呼吸困难。

en.t: Before long, the Master went to bed and felt pain in his chest and difficulty breathing.

units.source_text: 第三天黎明之前，与世长辞了。

en.t: Before dawn on the third day, he passed away.

units.source_text: 高桥四段来电话告诉我这一噩耗。

en.t: Takahashi, fourth dan, called to tell me the sad news.

units.source_text: 我打开挡雨板，太阳还没露出脸来。

en.t: I opened the rain shutters, and the sun had not yet shown its face.

units.source_text: 我想，是不是因为前天我们造访名人，影响了他的健康呢？

en.t: I wondered whether our visit to the Master the day before yesterday had affected his health.
